restroom_basins.title: Two washbasins
restroom_basins.speaker: protagonist
restroom_basins.text: Both levers are shut. One strainer is dull and the other is the colour of the taps. Along the bottom of the mirror, a new clip sits where the two panes meet.
restroom_basins.repeat_text: Two shut taps, two different strainers, one new clip.

restroom_latch.title: Second cubicle
restroom_latch.speaker: protagonist
restroom_latch.text: The indicator shows a narrow band of red. The end of the bolt is visible through a gap in the plate. From here you cannot see what is keeping it there.
restroom_latch.repeat_text: A sliver of red and the end of the bolt.

restroom_drain.title: Floor grate
restroom_drain.speaker: protagonist
restroom_drain.text: The grate interrupts one of the ruled lines in the floor. A small piece of warmer tile sits by its edge. The slots are clear.
restroom_drain.repeat_text: A little warmer tile at the edge of the grate.

record.text: One small piece of tile beside the restroom drain is a different colour.
